name: domindev-momentum
description: High-performance portfolio and service website for DominDev

scripts.build:assets: npm run optimize:images && npm run minify && npm run update:sitemap
scripts.test:quality: npm run test:html && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dev: echo 'Development server - just open index.html in browser'
scripts.dev:leads: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.dev:brief: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.dev:wrangler: npm run build && npx wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.help:
echo '
Available commands:
  npm run build           - Create the Cloudflare Pages artifact in dist/
  npm run build:assets    - Regenerate images, minified CSS and sitemap
  npm run minify:css      - Minify CSS files
  npm run minify          - Minify CSS files
  npm run watch           - Watch CSS changes and auto-minify
  npm run optimize:images - Generate optimized image variants (AVIF, WebP, JPEG)
  npm test                - Run all quality gates
'

author: DominDev
